text: Abraham had once pleaded for Sodom. In Genesis 22 the three days of travel are a kind of suspended sentence; outwardly nothing happens, and in significance everything happens. Faith here takes the form of a structured relation, in which obedience stands beside horror and neither is suffered to prevail over the other. The servants, the wood, the knife, and the fire are named with care, so that the instruments of the act are already present before the act itself.
